rationale: The plan correctly treats the matrix as RSEM expected counts, rounds them for DESeq2 with the rounding recorded, uses them unchanged in edgeR, never substitutes TPM/FPKM, states explicitly that the length offset is lost and names the per-sample genes.results files as the input needed; it loses a point only for not spelling out the tximport type='rsem' import path (with zero effective lengths set to one) that those files would enable. QC includes library sizes, PCA and distance heatmap coloured by condition with an explicit keep-and-inspect policy for sample_01 plus a labelled sensitivity refit. Filtering is minimal and tied to the smallest group size, normalization is inside the model (median-of-ratios / TMM), the design and control reference level and contrast are explicit, BH at 0.05 with apeglm shrinkage and lfcThreshold-in-test are stated. Enrichment is correctly omitted and the report records method, versions, design, thresholds, tested/significant counts, seed, sessionInfo and the design caveats.
